system.description:
You engulf a weapon in Fire chakra, coating it in a flame. If you let go of the weapon or it is taken from you, the Fire disperses. While you maintain concentration on this jutsu, you can engulf another weapon you are holding as a bonus action.

Your weapon deals an additional 1d8 Fire damage, twice per turn. The Fire sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, its bonus damage increases to 2d8. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, its bonus damage increases to 3d8.
